_comment: Rename to manifest.json to activate custom marble skins. Keyed by marble number (1-100). Each entry is EITHER an image OR a glb (paths are relative to /public, or absolute https URLs). Any marble not listed uses its default solid color. Optional owner/ownerLink fields show on the /gallery page (an entry may have owner info with no skin). Delete this file (or leave it as manifest.example.json) to keep the default colored marbles.
